# `fluxsim describe`

Report this installation's identity, engine capabilities and full command tree, so a consumer can render UI without lagging the CLI.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim describe [options]
```

## Examples

```bash
# identity, capabilities and the command tree
fluxsim describe --self --json
```

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--self` |  | describe this installation (currently the only mode) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
